therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Live attenuated Listeria monocytogenes-based immunotherapy targeting HPV-16 E7
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Immune system activation against HPV-transformed cervical cancer cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: High risk locally advanced cervical cancer patients

safety_signals: Gastrointestinal events (colitis, GERD, intestinal obstruction, rectal hemorrhage)
